visualCharacteristics.purpose: live lounge search: city autocomplete, travel class or frequent flyer status select and a search button in a grey band; results as lounge cards
traits: bold heading 'Finden Sie Ihre Lounge' above a row of two underlined fields and a yellow button on the right
white result cards: square image left (on top below 1025px), category badge, name, location, opening hours table, hint
amenities with icons next to the details from 1025px, behind a 'View amenities' toggle below

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, label | value, all rows optional: Image base | /content/dam/lh/images/lounges (data-dcep imageBaseUrl); Lounge purchase | off (removes Economy). UI strings come from GET /service/api/labels/loungefinder/lh/{lang} with English/German defaults; any can be overridden with a row of the same name (Heading, Submit label, No results label, ...). Cities: GET /service/api/catalogs/lounges/cities. Search: GET /service/api/catalogs/lounges/{status}/{city}; Economy: Yilu products plus .../BUS/{city}.

usage: /{cc}/{ll}/lounges and /{cc}/{ll}/tips-senior-travellers: the .loungefinder component, in its own grey section.
reuseGuidance: Reuse unchanged; author an empty block. Requests and mappers are in scripts/lh-api.js (loungeCitiesRequest, loungesRequest, mapLoungeCities, mapLounges, loungeImageUrl); the block exports readLoungeFinderSettings, loadLoungeFinderContext and loadLounges for tools/importer/test-widgets.mjs.
